packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/cond.Condition.constructor@202: Takes an operator, field name, raw value, and optional options, and throws an assertion error if the field has no known type, the operator is not valid for that field, or the value is null (or an empty string for non-nullable string fields). On success it stores the raw value, the original unparsed value, op, field, options, and type name, and sets `value` to the type's parse result (or the raw value if the type has no parser).
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/cond.Condition.eval@239: Takes a transaction-like object and returns a boolean by reading `object[this.field]` and applying the operator for this condition's type. Null string fields are treated as '', an undefined field value yields false, strings are lowercased before comparison, number fields with `outflow` or `inflow` options return false for the excluded sign (outflow negates the value), and any unrecognized operator or unmatched path returns false. Invalid regular expressions in `matches` are logged and yield false, and `onBudget`/`offBudget` return false when `object._account` is absent. The method does not modify the object or the condition.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/cond.Condition.getValue@449: Returns the parsed value stored on the condition at construction time, without modification or recomputation.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/cond.Condition.serialize@453: Returns a plain object containing `op`, `field`, `value` (the original unparsed value passed to the constructor), and `type`, plus an `options` property only when the condition was constructed with truthy options. It does not alter the condition's state.

packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.isValidOp@99: Takes a field key and an operator and returns a boolean. It returns false if the field has no entry in FIELD_TYPES or if the operator is in that field's disallowedOps. Otherwise it returns true when the operator is in the ops list for the field's type or in the field's internalOps, and false in all other cases. It does not modify any state.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.getValidOps@110: Takes a field key and returns a new array of operators. For an unknown field it returns an empty array. For a known field it returns the ops of the field's type from TYPE_INFO, in their original order, with the field's disallowedOps removed. internalOps are not included. The shared TYPE_INFO arrays are not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.deserializeField@120: Takes a field name and returns an object with a `field` property. 'amount-inflow' maps to { field: 'amount', options: { inflow: true } } and 'amount-outflow' maps to { field: 'amount', options: { outflow: true } }. Any other input is returned as { field } with the value unchanged.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.getFieldError@130: Takes an error type string and returns a fixed user-facing message. 'no-null', 'no-empty-array' and 'no-empty-string' share the message 'Value cannot be empty'. Each other known type maps to its own message, and any unrecognized type returns the internal-error message with the support link.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.sortNumbers@153: Takes two values and returns a two-element array containing them in ascending order, using the < operator. If num1 is less than num2 it returns [num1, num2], otherwise [num2, num1], so equal inputs are returned in swapped order with the same values. Inputs are not coerced or validated and nothing is mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.parse@160: Takes a rule item and returns a new object derived from it, except in one case noted below. For 'set-split-amount' items with method 'fixed-amount' it returns a shallow copy; for other methods it returns the same item reference. For 'number' items it returns a shallow copy. For 'string' items it returns a copy whose value is '' when the original value is null or undefined. For 'boolean' items it returns a copy with the value unchanged. For all other types it returns a copy with error set to null, overwriting any existing error. The input is not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.unparse@186: Takes a rule item, removes its `error` and `inputKey` properties, and returns the result without mutating the input. For 'set-split-amount' with method 'fixed-amount' it returns the remaining properties unchanged. With method 'fixed-percent' it also sets value to parseFloat(value) when value is truthy, otherwise to the original falsy value. Other 'set-split-amount' methods return the remaining object unchanged. For 'number' it returns the remaining properties. For 'string' it sets a null or undefined value to ''. For 'boolean' it sets a null or undefined value to false. For all other types it returns the remaining properties unchanged.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.makeValue@220: Takes a value and a condition object and returns a new condition object with error set to null and value set according to the condition. For 'oneOf' and 'notOneOf' conditions the value is value || [], so falsy inputs become an empty array and truthy inputs are kept as given. For 'number' conditions with a null or undefined value the value is 0. In all other cases the value is kept as given. The condition is not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.getApproxNumberThreshold@234: Takes a number and returns Math.round(Math.abs(number) * 0.075), a non-negative integer equal to 7.5% of the number's magnitude rounded to the nearest integer, with halves rounded upward by Math.round. It does not mutate state.

packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.resetState@65: Replaces the module-level in-memory rule map with an empty Map and creates new firstchar (on `imported_payee`) and payee `RuleIndexer` instances, discarding any previously indexed rules. Takes no arguments and returns nothing.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.invert@76: Returns a new object whose keys are the original values and whose values are the original keys. When two entries share a value, the later entry's key overwrites the earlier one.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.fromInternalField@87: Returns a shallow copy of the object with `field` replaced by its public name from the inverted schema field map, or left unchanged when no mapping exists. The input is not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.toInternalField@94: Returns a shallow copy of the object with `field` replaced by its internal column name from the schema field map, or left unchanged when no mapping exists. The input is not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.parseArray@101: Parses a JSON string (or passes through a non-string value) and returns it as an array. Throws `RuleError('internal')` if JSON parsing fails or the parsed value is not an array.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.parseConditionsOrActions@115: For a truthy input, parses it into an array via `parseArray` and maps each item through `fromInternalField`, returning the resulting array. For a falsy input, returns an empty array.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.serializeConditionsOrActions@119: Maps each item of the array through `toInternalField` and returns the JSON string of the resulting array. The input array is not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.makeRule@170: Builds a `Rule` from the `toJS` form of `data`. If construction throws a `RuleError`, it logs a warning and returns null; any other error is rethrown. On success it applies the current id mappings via `migrateIds` and returns the rule.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.loadRules@190: Resets state, then loads every rule from the database with non-null conditions and actions and `tombstone = 0`, mapping legacy stages 'cleanup' and 'modify' to 'pre'. Each rule that builds successfully is added to the in-memory map and both indexers. It then unsubscribes any previous sync listener and subscribes `onApplySync`. Resolves to nothing.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getRules@219: Returns a new array containing the rules currently held in the in-memory map. It does not query the database.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.insertRule@224: Validates the rule as a new record (requiring `conditions`, `actions`, a valid `stage` and `conditionsOp`), throwing if validation fails. It then inserts the serialized rule with a generated UUID and returns the result of `db.insertWithUUID`.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.updateRule@231: Validates the rule in update mode, checking `stage` and `conditionsOp` only when those keys are present, and throws if a present value is invalid. It then writes the serialized rule to the `rules` table with `db.update` and returns that result.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.deleteRule@236: Returns false and deletes nothing if any schedule row references the rule id. Otherwise it deletes the rule row and returns true.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.onApplySync@252: Applies incoming `rules` changes to the in-memory map and indexers: tombstoned rows are removed, and other rows are rebuilt via `makeRule`, replacing the prior indexer entries when the rebuilt rule is valid. If any changed table name contains 'mapping', it re-runs `migrateIds` on every current rule. Returns nothing.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getRuleIdFromScheduleId@293: Returns the `rule` value of the schedule with the given id, or null if no such schedule exists or its rule is empty.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getAllRuleIdsFromSchedules@304: Returns the non-null rule ids of all schedules, omitting entries equal to `excluding`. Duplicate ids are not removed.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.runRules@323: Applies the ranked candidate rules to a transaction in sequence and returns the resulting transaction. Missing `payee` or `category` fields are treated as null during matching and are removed from the result if they remain null. The running balance is fetched at most once, and only if a rule that runs reads it. When the transaction has a schedule, the schedule's own rule runs unconditionally and other schedule-linked rules are skipped. `category_group` is refreshed after each rule whenever `category` has changed. The result is finalized with synthetic fields stripped.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.conditionSpecialCases@460: For a null or undefined condition, returns it unchanged. For an `is` condition on `category` with a null value, returns an `and` condition that also requires not a transfer and not a parent. For an `isNot` condition on `category` with a null value, returns an `and` condition that also requires not a parent. Any other condition is returned unchanged.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.conditionsToAQL@493: Converts conditions (Condition instances or plain objects) into AQL filter expressions and returns `{ filters, errors }`. Conditions that fail to construct are dropped, and their error types are collected in `errors`. Special cases are applied when `applySpecialCases` is true, and null entries are filtered out. Throws `Error` for an unhandled operator.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.applyActions@755: Converts the given actions into `Action` instances and returns null if any action fails to parse. It then prepares each transaction (computing running balance only if an action references it), prefetches `BALANCE_OF` values, executes the actions, ungroups the results, and finalizes each one. It persists the finalized transactions with `batchUpdateTransactions` and returns that result.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getRulesForPayee@830: Takes a payeeId and returns, as a new array, the distinct in-memory rules whose payee action targets that id, ordered by rankRules. Returns an empty array when no rule matches. It does not modify any rule state.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getIsSetterRules@841: Generator that yields serialized in-memory rules matching the given stage, with exactly one 'set' action on actionField (value equal to actionValue when provided) and exactly one 'is' or 'isNot' condition on condField (value equal to condValue when provided). Yields nothing when no rule matches, and it does not modify rules.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getOneOfSetterRules@868: Generator that yields serialized in-memory rules matching the given stage, with exactly one 'set' action on actionField and exactly one 'oneOf' condition on condField. The action value must equal actionValue and the condition's value list must contain condValue, each check skipped when the argument is null or undefined. Yields nothing when no rule matches.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.updatePayeeRenameRule@896: Takes a list of imported payee names and a target payee name. If a pre-stage oneOf imported_payee rule already sets payee to the target, it merges the non-empty names into that rule's condition values, persists the update, and returns that rule's id; otherwise it inserts a new pre-stage rule (conditions: imported_payee oneOf fromNames, action: set payee to the target) and returns the result of insertRule, with the names passed through unfiltered.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getProbableCategory@932: Takes a list of transactions and returns the category that appears most often among those with a truthy category, provided its count is at least 3, otherwise null. Ties resolve to the earliest-scoring entry, and if the first transaction has no category the result is null. Throws a TypeError when given an empty array.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.updateCategoryRules@952: Async. For the payees of the given transactions with learn_categories enabled, loads non-parent transactions in open accounts from 180 days before the oldest given date through 180 days ahead, and for each non-null payee having one of its five most recent transactions among the inputs, derives a probable category and then updates existing is-payee category rules to it where they differ, or inserts a new rule if none exists and no oneOf rule already sets that category. Returns immediately for an empty input, and returns nothing otherwise.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getRunningBalanceBeforeTransaction@1072: Async. Returns the sum of amounts of non-parent transactions in the given account that come before the transaction: those dated earlier, or dated the same day with a lower sort_order (or, when sort_order is null, ordered ahead by non-null sort_order or lower id), excluding the transaction itself. Returns 0 when there are no such rows.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.prefetchBalanceOfForTransaction@1114: Async. Collects the distinct BALANCE_OF literals across the given formulas, resolves each to an account id, and returns a new Map from each literal to the running balance before the transaction for that account, or to 0 when the account cannot be resolved. Does not modify the transaction or the accounts map.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.actionsReferenceBalance@1146: Pure check that returns true if any action's options.template or options.formula string contains the word 'balance' (case-insensitive, word-bounded). Actions without options or without those strings are ignored, and BALANCE_OF(...) usages do not count.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.prepareTransactionForRules@1158: Async. Returns a new object copying the transaction and adding payee_name when the payee exists, balance initialized to 0, _account and _account_name when the account is set (taken from the accounts map if present, otherwise fetched), balance replaced by the running balance only when includeBalance is true and an account is set, and _category_name and category_group when the category exists. The input object is not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.resolvePayeeNameForRules@1210: Async. Acts only when the object has a payee_name property and payee equals 'new': if payee_name is truthy it sets payee to the id of the existing payee with that name or of a newly inserted one, otherwise it sets payee to null. Mutates the object in place and returns nothing.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.refreshCategoryGroupIfChanged@1239: Async. Compares the transaction's category (null-normalized) with lastCategoryId and returns lastCategoryId unchanged without a database lookup when they match. When they differ, it sets category_group from the new category's cat_group (or undefined if the category is not found), or deletes category_group when the category is cleared, mutates the transaction, and returns the new category id normalized to null when absent.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.finalizeTransactionForRules@1258: Async. Mutates and returns the same transaction: if it has payee_name, resolves a 'new' payee and then deletes payee_name; deletes balance, category_group and _balanceOfPrefetched when present, and deletes parent_amount, parent_notes, parent_imported_payee, parent_payee and parent_account. The same balance, _balanceOfPrefetched and parent_* fields are removed from each subtransaction when subtransactions exist.

packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.assert@12: Returns nothing when `test` is truthy. When `test` is falsy, throws a `RuleError` built from `type` and `msg`, and narrows `test` to truthy for the caller's type checking.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.computeScore@38: Takes a rule and returns a number: the sum of `OP_SCORES` for each condition's operator, where an operator with no score contributes 0 and is logged. The sum is doubled when every condition's operator is one of is, isNot, isapprox, oneOf, or notOneOf, which includes the case of no conditions (result 0). The rule is not modified.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule._rankRules@63: Takes an array of rules and returns a new array sorted in ascending order by computed score, with ties broken by ascending comparison of `getId()` values. The input array is not mutated, and the result is the same for any input ordering of the same rules.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.rankRules@87: Takes an iterable of rules and returns a new array made by ranking the `pre` rules, then the normal rules (every stage other than 'pre' or 'post'), then the `post` rules, each group ordered by `_rankRules`, and concatenating them in that order. Every input rule appears exactly once in the output.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.migrateIds@112: Mutates the given rule in place, leaving `rawValue` untouched. For id conditions with `is` or `isNot`, sets `value` and `unparsedValue` to the mapped `rawValue` (or `rawValue` if no mapping is found, including when the mapping is falsy). For `oneOf` and `notOneOf`, sets `value` to the deduplicated mapped array and `unparsedValue` to a copy of it. For id actions with op `set`, sets `value` to the mapped `rawValue`. Other operators are left unchanged.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.iterateIds@163: Walks the rules in array order and, for each condition on an id field matching `fieldName`, calls `func` with the rule and each referenced id (`value` for is/isNot, each element for oneOf/notOneOf). If `func` returns a truthy value for a condition, the walk moves to the next rule and skips that rule's remaining conditions and actions. Otherwise, for each id action on `fieldName` with op `set`, it calls `func` with the action's value, and a truthy return ends the action loop for that rule. Returns nothing and does not itself modify rules.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.parseRecurDate@220: Takes a recurrence description and returns `{ type: 'recur', schedule }`, where `schedule` is an `RSchedule` built from `recurConfigToRSchedule(desc)` with `skipWeekend` and `weekendSolve` (from `desc.weekendSolveMode`) passed as its data. Any error thrown while building the schedule is rethrown as a `RuleError` with type 'parse-recur-date' and the original message.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.parseDateString@239: Takes a value and returns null if it is not a string or is not of length 10, 7, or 4, or if it fails ISO validation. For length 10, validates `YYYY-MM-DD` and returns `{ type: 'date', date }`; for length 7, validates `YYYY-MM` (by appending `-01`) and returns `{ type: 'month', date }`; for length 4, validates `YYYY` (by appending `-01-01`) and returns `{ type: 'year', date }`. The returned `date` is the original input string, unchanged.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.parseBetweenAmount@268: Takes an object with `num1` and `num2` and returns `{ type: 'between', num1, num2 }` with the values unchanged when both are of JavaScript type 'number', otherwise returns null. No range or NaN check is performed.

packages/loot-core/src/platform/server/s.likePatternToRegex@7: Translates a SQL LIKE pattern string into a case-insensitive (`i` flag) RegExp, with no anchors. `%` becomes `.*`, `?` becomes `.`, and a backslash before `%`, `?`, or `\` makes that next character a literal. Every other character, including a backslash not followed by one of those three, is regex-escaped and matched literally.
packages/loot-core/src/platform/server/s.unicodeLike@33: Returns 0 if `pattern` is null or empty, and otherwise returns 1 if the translated regex matches anywhere within `value` (with null or empty `value` treated as `''`), else 0. Compiled regexes are memoized by pattern string in an LRU cache capped at 500 entries; the function does not modify its arguments.
